dialogues.speaker: Durgar
dialogues.text: The fact that Sumeru people are living in a place where trees and flowers flourish instead of struggling amidst barren deserts is all thanks to the kindness of the Lord Kusanali.

dialogues.speaker: Durgar
dialogues.text: Greater Lord Rukkhadevata left roots and nutrients to Sumeru, which have now been inherited and protected by Lesser Lord Kusanali.

dialogues.speaker: Durgar
dialogues.text: So now, all our harvests are born from her mercy.

dialogues.speaker: Durgar
dialogues.text: And since I live by carpentry, which is closely related to trees, I am even more grateful to the Dendro Archon!
